# PNW AI Directory

> AI-readable contractor directory for the Pacific Northwest. Launch verticals: plumbers, HVAC contractors, roofers, painters, and pressure washers.

PNW AI Directory helps homeowners, property managers, local organizations, and AI assistants understand which contractor data is verified, missing, claimed, or still demo-only.

## Primary pages

- Home: /
- Directory: /directory
- Blog: /blog
- Community programs: /programs
- Strategy: /strategy

## Launch verticals

- /directory/plumbers — emergency plumbing profile data, license fields, service radius, after-hours rules.
- /directory/hvac — heat pumps, furnace repair, rebates, maintenance plans, emergency heat rules.
- /directory/roofers — leak response, materials, roof types, storm windows, warranties.
- /directory/painters — interior/exterior/cabinet painting, prep, low-VOC, lead-safe proof.
- /directory/pressure-washers — soft wash, surface types, runoff controls, water-conscious cleaning.

## Data policy

Demo profiles are not verified businesses. Verified profiles require explicit proof checks before claims are published.

## Social purpose

Premium profiles subsidize community visibility, contractor education, cleanup projects, water-conscious work, weatherization education, and safer housing resources.
